# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

<!-- cap-evolve:insights-append-below -->

## tau2 reward decomposition (verified from reward_info, all 10 val rollouts)
- CONFIRMED FACT (not a gate result): `tau2_reward = DB_match × COMMUNICATE`. Both components
  must be 1.0 for reward 1.0. The `action_checks[*].action_match` flags are INFORMATIONAL —
  currently-passing tasks 8, 17, 37 each have at least one `action_match=False` yet score 1.0.
  Implication: do NOT diagnose from action_match; diagnose from `reward_breakdown` (DB vs
  COMMUNICATE) and the `communicate_checks[*].info` (the exact string the agent must say).
- Task 11 pattern: DB can already be correct while the task scores 0 purely because a required
  numeric `communicate_check` (here "5244", the cabin-downgrade refund) was never said — the
  agent hand-computed it wrong from market fares. Fix = a tool that returns the exact number.
- Promising but not yet tried (pending this candidate's RESULT): enriching the WRITE tools'
  return with an explicit charge/refund field so post-write COMMUNICATE checks are also covered.
